verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer API access, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no API or credential-issuance capability: OpenAPI probes all return 404, and the bizfile portal sits behind bot management. 'User Access' only controls which people may submit filings on an entity's behalf, which is an adjacent human-authorization control, not scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
